headword: シンガーソングライター
reading: しんがーそんぐらいたー
gloss: singer-songwriter (a musician who writes and performs their own songs)

definitions.gloss: singer-songwriter; a musician who writes and performs their own songs
definitions.explanation: A musician who both composes and performs their own songs — typically writing their own lyrics and music and singing them themselves. The term entered Japanese music journalism in the 1970s with the rise of folk and adult-contemporary singer-songwriters and is now standard vocabulary for anyone whose performances feature their own original material.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}なシンガーソングライター。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{自分|じぶん}で{曲|きょく}を{書|か}くシンガーソングライターだ。
examples.english: She is a singer-songwriter who writes her own songs.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}のシンガーソングライターが{大|おお}きな{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: A young singer-songwriter is drawing major attention.

examples.japanese: ライブハウスで{演奏|えんそう}を{続|つづ}けながら{自作|じさく}の{曲|きょく}を{磨|みが}いてきたシンガーソングライターが、ついにメジャーデビューを{果|は}たした。
examples.english: A singer-songwriter who has been polishing her original songs while continuing to play at live music venues has finally made her major-label debut.

notes:
シンガーソングライター is the English compound "singer-songwriter" naturalized into Japanese. It is the standard term in Japanese music writing for an artist who writes and performs their own songs.

IMPLIED MEANING:
- The artist writes both lyrics ({作詞|さくし}) and music ({作曲|さっきょく})
- The artist also performs the songs themselves
- Often associated with acoustic, folk, J-pop, and adult-contemporary genres, but used across all genres including rock, hip-hop, and electronic

FORMS:
- Frequently abbreviated as SSW in Japanese music journalism (e.g., "{若手|わかて}SSW" = "young singer-songwriters")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女性|じょせい}シンガーソングライター: female singer-songwriter
- {若手|わかて}シンガーソングライター: young/up-and-coming singer-songwriter
- ベテランシンガーソングライター: veteran singer-songwriter
- シンガーソングライターとして{活躍|かつやく}する: to be active as a singer-songwriter
- シンガーソングライターを{目指|めざ}す: to aim to become a singer-songwriter
- {弾|ひ}き{語|がた}りのシンガーソングライター: a singer-songwriter who accompanies herself on guitar/piano

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {作詞|さくし}{家|か}: lyricist — someone who writes lyrics (often for other performers)
- {作曲|さっきょく}{家|か}: composer — someone who writes music
- {歌手|かしゅ}: singer (general) — does not imply songwriting
- アーティスト: artist (loanword) — the broader, more flexible term covering all sorts of musicians and performers
- ミュージシャン: musician (loanword) — emphasizes instrumental skill; partly overlaps with アーティスト
- {弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り: self-accompanied performance — describes the performance style often associated with singer-songwriters but is a separate concept

USAGE:
- A pop idol who sings songs written by professional songwriting teams is not typically called a シンガーソングライター — the term implies meaningful authorship of one's material.
- The katakana spelling is invariant; you will not see this written in kanji. Pronunciation reflects the English origin: しんがー・そんぐ・らいたー.
